text:
Aisha Kapoor: quick note — our ensemble canary is showing ~0.4% parse failures on tool-calling, but the raw logs show the models are streaming fragmented JSON pieces that get merged incorrectly at the aggregator layer.
Tom B: ugh. is this the kv-cache + streaming combo again? any sample log?
Aisha Kapoor: yes, looks like fragments end mid-escape sequence. sample: 
```
[model1] ...\"args\": {\"msg\": \"Hello, wor
[model2] ld\", \"id\": 123} ...
```
merge becomes `Hello, world` sometimes but other times we lose the `\"` and the parser chokes.
Priya Patel: that explains the JSONDecodeError spikes. are we already prefix-guarding streams with sentinels?
Aisha Kapoor: not reliably. the ensemble arbiter just concatenates chunks from replicas as they arrive to present a single JSON. at PTQ int8 canaries timing changes yield different chunk boundaries and thus different failures.
Jin Park: two quick options: 1) NDJSON per tool call (one JSON object per line) so we can parse line-by-line, or 2) add an explicit boundary marker like `--RR--BND--` between partials and strip on reassembly.
Tom B: prefer NDJSON for simplicity but that changes the contract. maybe do a streaming-flagged fallback: if chunked-merge fails parse, re-request non-streaming full response for that call (counts against retry budget).
Priya Patel: agreed on fallback. we should also add a small reassembly library in the caller that attempts heuristics before retrying: escape-closure probe, balance-braces check, and minimal repairs (append closing brackets/quotes) when safe. log all repairs for telemetry.
Aisha Kapoor: sketch of reassembly heuristic we tried: 
```
function reassemble(chunks):
  text = ''.join(chunks)
  if is_well_formed_json(text): return text
  if balance_braces(text) and ends_with_quote_safe(text): return try_close_quotes(text)
  return None  # trigger non-streaming retry
```
Tom B: add a short TTL to merged fragments — if fragments for a single call arrive >200ms apart from different replicas, treat as separate attempts (helps avoid cross-response merging).
Jin Park: telemetry: emit `fragment_boundary_mismatch` with counts, and tag with model+quantization (ptq/int8) + canary-id. helps correlate with int8 timing.
Priya Patel: agreed. we should also add a canary that toggles "force whole-response" for a sample fraction to measure true parse-error delta without repair heuristics.
Aisha Kapoor: creating a quick runbook: 
- Turn on NDJSON option in ensemble arbiter for canary 5201234X.
- Add reassembly lib with conservative repairs and logging.
- Implement non-streaming fallback for parse failures (retry budget aware).
- Emit fragment telemetry + quant tag.

deploy-bot: canary updated on eng-ml staging (5201234600) — NDJSON toggled for 1% traffic. :rocket:
Tom B: I'll instrument the repair-probe metric and add a kibana dashboard slice.
Priya Patel: will add the telemetry tags and a small eval to compare pre/post parsing error rate.
Aisha Kapoor: thanks — I'll follow up with the sample diffs once the canary runs for a few hours. :thumbsup:
